_comment: Identities that are known to be running unaudited, and are deliberately not
gated in index.json. fleet_drift.py lists these separately and does NOT count
them as drift, so that a permanent open item cannot redline the signal and
train everyone to ignore it. A new identity appearing is the alarm; a known
one staying open is a backlog entry.
Adding an entry here is a decision to keep publishing without covering it, so
each one carries a reason and, where a page exists that explains the gap, a
link to it. Removing an entry is what happens when the gap closes.
This file is NOT part of the frozen path spec and no client reads it.

acknowledged.reason: Liveness undecidable from the signed log: the entry is a superseded revision on the glm-5-3-flash gpu03 CVM whose containers a later up of another file either removed as orphans (shared compose project) or left in place (per-model project); the log records no project. What it declares cannot be serving: the V12Q8 replicas that answer today reserve the same GPUs. Decided by the maintainer 2026-11-06 ('acknowledge gpu03') after the nine comparable gpu23/four-CVM leftovers were reviewed to the same 'superseded, not running since' outcome. named only by the superseded gpu03 revision bcd313cf, which now has a page (reviewed 2026-11-20: its two engines ran this image as the serving glm-5.3 engines from 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-02 and are superseded; no attributed container of a serving revision runs it today)
acknowledged.closes_when: near.ai records the compose project (and an env-overlay hash) in the compose_up/compose_down action, or exposes the live container list, so liveness becomes derivable; or the revision is reviewed

acknowledged.reason: Third-party private image (Levanto Labs Sage 2) running inside the small-models CVM (cm-gpu13, measured e8416a02). Docker Hub refuses an anonymous pull, no build attestation and no public source exist (positive control in the same run resolved), so its contents cannot be reviewed. The page is INCONCLUSIVE on the image and records the configuration it runs under: own network, no Docker socket, a socket filter that allows only Info and GetQuote. Decided by the maintainer 2026-11-19 ('do the Sage page').
acknowledged.closes_when: near.ai or Levanto publishes the image's source or a build attestation that lets it be reviewed; or the container no longer runs on a CVM that serves teemoon-reachable models; or the digest stops being named by a running recipe revision.
